Let me just write the failing request to a file from the test and then debug it directly. Let me modify the test to dump the request to a file on failure.

Actually simpler: let me make the test dump to /app/tmp/fail.json and re-run.

arguments.command:
cd /app/tmp && sed -i "s|(i, r, bp, req)|(i, r, bp, req)|" t_compile.py && python3 - <<'EOF'
s=open('t_compile.py').read()
s=s.replace("assert r.get('status') == 'ok', (i, r, bp, req)",
            "assert r.get('status') == 'ok', (open('/app/tmp/fail.json','w').write(json.dumps(req)), i, r, bp, req)")
open('t_compile.py','w').write(s)
EOF
cd /app/tmp && timeout 170 python3 t_compile.py 60 1 2>&1 | tail -3
